segments.sn22.137:1.2: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.137:1.4: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.137:1.5: Vedanā aniccā … pe … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ;
segments.sn22.137:1.9: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo chando pahātabbo”ti.
